rows.en: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming
rows.ne: 1.2 कार्यक्रमलाई दिशा दिन MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने
rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide the programme
rows.note: Reuses the supplied unreviewed activity-label candidate verbatim.

rows.en: Group work – MHPSS Needs Assessment Case Study
rows.ne: समूह कार्य – MHPSS आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखासम्बन्धी घटना अध्ययन
rows.bt: Group work – Case study on the assessment of MHPSS needs

rows.en: After a sudden increase in violence in a neighbouring area, large numbers of people are travelling to your region.
rows.ne: छिमेकी क्षेत्रमा हिंसा अचानक बढेपछि ठूलो सङ्ख्यामा मानिसहरू तपाईंको क्षेत्रमा आइरहेका छन्।
rows.bt: After a sudden increase in violence in a neighbouring area, large numbers of people are coming into your area.
rows.note: Reclassified as general: this is scenario background, not safety guidance.

rows.en: The population is mainly women and children, and many of the new arrivals appear to be distressed.
rows.ne: जनसङ्ख्यामा मुख्यतः महिला र बालबालिका छन्, र नयाँ आएका धेरै जना व्यथामा रहेका देखिन्छन्।
rows.bt: The population consists mainly of women and children, and many of those newly arrived appear to be in distress.
rows.note: Uses the frozen distress candidate and preserves the observational qualification without adding a diagnosis or impaired functioning.

rows.en: Your organization’s programme manager wants to establish some MHPSS activities to support the new arrivals.
rows.ne: तपाईंको संस्थाका कार्यक्रम व्यवस्थापक नयाँ आएका मानिसहरूलाई सहयोग गर्न केही MHPSS गतिविधिहरू सुरु गर्न चाहन्छन्।
rows.bt: Your organisation's programme manager wants to start some MHPSS activities to help the newly arrived people.
rows.note: The recurring standalone term 'programme' is not supplied in the glossary; proposed nonclinical wording: [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence].

rows.en: Instruction: To ensure you design an effective programme, you want to understand the needs, resources and priorities of the people who are arriving to the area.
rows.ne: निर्देशन: तपाईंले प्रभावकारी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा गर्ने कुरा सुनिश्चित गर्न यस क्षेत्रमा आइरहेका मानिसहरूका आवश्यकता, स्रोत र प्राथमिकताहरू बुझ्न चाहनुहुन्छ।
rows.bt: Instructions: You want to understand the needs, resources and priorities of the people coming into this area to ensure that you design an effective program.
rows.note: Uses the proposed nonclinical wording [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] for the recurring standalone term 'programme'; the glossary remains unchanged. The existing wording expresses enabling preparation of an outline rather than ensuring the design of an effective programme. The revision restores the assurance and programme-design meaning.

rows.en: What steps would you take to assess the MHPSS needs and resources of this population?
rows.ne: यस जनसमूहका MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्न तपाईं के-कस्ता कदम चाल्नुहुन्छ?
rows.bt: What steps would you take to assess the MHPSS needs and resources of this population?

rows.en: 15 min
rows.ne: 15 मिनेट
rows.bt: 15 minutes
rows.note: Reclassified as general: this specifies a duration, not a check.

rows.en: MHPSS Assessment
rows.ne: MHPSS लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: MHPSS assessment
rows.note: Reclassified as general: this is a topic heading rather than an activity instruction.

rows.en: Why is Activity 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources included in the MSP?
rows.ne: MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने गतिविधि 1.2 लाई MSP मा किन समावेश गरिएको छ?
rows.bt: Why is activity 1.2, assessing MHPSS needs and resources, included in the MSP?
rows.note: Preserves the source's shortened activity wording without adding the omitted purpose clause from the full activity label.

rows.en: What happens if we plan our programmes without being guided by MHPSS needs assessments or situational analysis?
rows.ne: MHPSS आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा वा परिस्थितिको विश्लेषणबाट मार्गदर्शन नलिई हामीले आफ्ना कार्यक्रमहरूको योजना बनायौँ भने के हुन्छ?
rows.bt: What happens if we plan our programmes without taking guidance from an assessment of MHPSS needs or an analysis of the situation?
rows.note: Uses the proposed nonclinical wording [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] for the recurring standalone term 'programme'; the glossary remains unchanged.

rows.en: How would you approach doing an MHPSS needs assessment?
rows.ne: MHPSS आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा गर्न तपाईं कस्तो प्रक्रिया अपनाउनुहुन्छ?
rows.bt: What process do you follow to assess MHPSS needs?

rows.en: Prevalence assessment scenario
rows.ne: व्याप्तिको लेखाजोखासम्बन्धी परिदृश्य
rows.bt: Scenario concerning the assessment of prevalence
rows.note: Uses the frozen candidates; the statistical specificity of the prevalence wording remains unvalidated.

rows.en: During a meeting of the MHPSS TWG, a representative from Hope University (located in California, USA) raises their hand.
rows.ne: MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (MHPSS TWG) को बैठकका क्रममा California, USA मा रहेको Hope University का एक प्रतिनिधिले हात उठाउँछन्।
rows.bt: During a meeting of the MHPSS Technical Working Group (MHPSS TWG), a representative of Hope University, located in California, USA, raises a hand.

rows.en: They plan to conduct an assessment on the prevalence of PTSD and depression among the displaced population (sample of 1,000), starting next week.
rows.ne: उनीहरूले अर्को हप्तादेखि विस्थापित जनसङ्ख्यामा (1,000 को नमुना) [PTSD] र [depression] को व्याप्तिको लेखाजोखा गर्ने योजना बनाएका छन्।
rows.bt: They have planned to assess the prevalence of [PTSD] and [depression] in the displaced population (a sample of 1,000) starting next week.
rows.note: Retains PTSD and depression in exact source English and preserves the planned timing, displaced population and sample size.

rows.en: They are recognized experts on PTSD, already obtained funding and are ready to go.
rows.ne: उनीहरू PTSD का विशेषज्ञका रूपमा मानिएका छन्, उनीहरूले वित्तपोषण प्राप्त गरिसकेका छन् र काम थाल्न तयार छन्।
rows.bt: They are regarded as experts in PTSD, they have already received funding and are ready to start work.
rows.note: PTSD is retained unchanged; only the surrounding nonclinical wording is drafted. [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] can imply formal accreditation or authorization, which 'recognized experts' does not establish. The revision preserves recognition of expertise without adding credentialing.

rows.en: As MHPSS TWG co-chair, what questions would you ask and what advice would you give?
rows.ne: MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (MHPSS TWG) को सह-अध्यक्षका रूपमा तपाईं के-कस्ता प्रश्न सोध्नुहुन्छ र के सल्लाह दिनुहुन्छ?
rows.bt: As co-chair of the MHPSS Technical Working Group (MHPSS TWG), what questions would you ask and what advice would you give?

rows.en: MHPSS in Needs Assessments
rows.ne: आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखामा MHPSS
rows.bt: MHPSS in needs assessment
rows.note: Reclassified as general: this is a topic heading rather than an activity instruction.

rows.en: Review: Module Learning Objectives
rows.ne: पुनरावलोकन: मोड्युलका सिकाइ उद्देश्यहरू
rows.bt: Review: Learning objectives of the module

rows.en: Describe the role of humanitarian actors in supporting MHPSS coordination
rows.ne: MHPSS समन्वयमा सहयोग गर्न मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूको भूमिका वर्णन गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Describe the role of actors involved in humanitarian work in supporting MHPSS coordination.

rows.en: Explain the importance of MHPSS needs assessment in programme planning
rows.ne: कार्यक्रमको योजना बनाउँदा MHPSS आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखाको महत्त्व स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Explain the importance of assessing MHPSS needs when planning a programme.
rows.note: Uses the proposed nonclinical wording [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] for the recurring standalone term 'programme'; the glossary remains unchanged.
